actions: Check the topic/thread’s model selection or metadata first; a per-topic choice can override the default.
Then inspect invocation/session overrides, the active profile, nested project `.codex/config.toml`, global Codex config, and managed workspace/admin policy, in precedence order.
Compare the effective model shown for the topic with the configured GPT-5.6 Sol default.
blocked_actions: Do not switch or test another model.
evidence: The installed skill identifies prompt/thread context as the narrowest one-off scope.
It identifies project `.codex/config.toml` as a location for model defaults and global configuration as the cross-repository default.

response: The likely override is topic/thread-scoped; if absent, trace session/profile, nearest project config, global config, then managed policy. This is a read-only diagnosis only.
